reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Wisconsin
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Is the municipal police department an entity empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
*/

/* -------------------------------
   Scenario facts (question statement)
   ------------------------------- */

state(wisconsin).
focus_year(2021).

% The entity we are asking about.
query_entity(municipal_police_department).

% We model the context as an eviction action where a writ of restitution (eviction writ) exists.
eviction_action(eviction_case_1).
real_property(premises_1).
located_in_county(premises_1, dane).

% The writ at issue (writ of restitution).
writ_of_restitution(writ_1).
issued_in_eviction_action(writ_1, eviction_case_1).
relates_to_premises(writ_1, premises_1).

% The county sheriff (a distinct entity from a municipal police department).
sheriff_of_county(dane, sheriff_dane_county).

% Helper predicate summarizing the scenario in logic form.
scenario_statement :-
    state(wisconsin),
    focus_year(2021),
    query_entity(municipal_police_department),
    writ_of_restitution(Writ),
    issued_in_eviction_action(Writ, Case),
    eviction_action(Case),
    relates_to_premises(Writ, Premises),
    real_property(Premises),
    located_in_county(Premises, _County).


/* -------------------------------
   Statute translation (WI Stat  799.44 (2021))
   ------------------------------- */

% WI Stat  799.44(2): "the writ may be delivered to the sheriff for execution"
statute_wi_799_44_writ_may_be_delivered_to_sheriff_for_execution(Writ, Sheriff) :-
    writ_of_restitution(Writ),
    relates_to_premises(Writ, Premises),
    located_in_county(Premises, County),
    sheriff_of_county(County, Sheriff).

% WI Stat  799.44(4): Writ "directed to the sheriff of the county in which the real property is located"
statute_wi_799_44_writ_is_directed_to_county_sheriff(Writ, Sheriff) :-
    writ_of_restitution(Writ),
    relates_to_premises(Writ, Premises),
    located_in_county(Premises, County),
    sheriff_of_county(County, Sheriff).

/* Core legal conclusion from  799.44 for this question:
   An entity is empowered by law (under this statute) to execute the writ if it is the county sheriff
   to whom the writ is directed / to whom it may be delivered for execution.
*/
legal_entity_empowered_to_execute_writ(Entity, Writ) :-
    statute_wi_799_44_writ_is_directed_to_county_sheriff(Writ, Entity),
    statute_wi_799_44_writ_may_be_delivered_to_sheriff_for_execution(Writ, Entity).

/* For convenience: "empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction" in the scenario. */
legal_empowered_by_law_to_execute_eviction_writ(Entity) :-
    scenario_statement,
    writ_of_restitution(Writ),
    legal_entity_empowered_to_execute_writ(Entity, Writ).


/* -------------------------------
   Answer derivation (deterministic)
   ------------------------------- */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    query_entity(Entity),
    legal_empowered_by_law_to_execute_eviction_writ(Entity),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.


/* -------------------------------
   Main entrypoint
   ------------------------------- */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is the municipal police department an entity empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
